headline: Kong Announces Conference Agenda for API + AI Summit 2026
summary: Kong Inc., a leading developer of API and AI connectivity technologies, has announced the agenda for its ninth annual API + AI Summit on Sept. 30-Oct. 1 at the InterContinental in Los Angeles. The conference brings together the top engineers, architects, and technology leaders building today's AI innovations. The agenda features speakers from global brands including LinkedIn, The Vanguard Group, Southwest Airlines, and Spotify.

headline: Dow Cracks 53,000 As Amazon Joins The $3T Club And Oil Does The Heavy Lifting
summary: The Dow printed a fresh record above 53,000 as a sharp slide in crude oil handed the tape a broad rally and Amazon quietly became the second US company ever to cross the three-trillion-dollar market cap threshold.

headline: Boeing’s Smallest 737 Max Finally Wins FAA Certification After a Decade of Delays— but Passengers Still Won’t Board One Until 2027
summary: The FAA certifies Boeing's 737 Max 7 after years of delays and safety reviews. Delivery begins, but passengers may wait months.

headline: Boeing (BA) Wins FAA Approval For 737 MAX 7 After Years Of Review
summary: The FAA has certified the Boeing 737 MAX 7, the smallest member of the MAX family. This is the first new aircraft certification for Boeing since the MAX crashes and follows a lengthy regulatory review. The approval clears a path for deliveries to Southwest Airlines, a key customer for the MAX 7. For investors watching Boeing, ticker NYSE:BA, the 737 MAX 7 certification marks a significant regulatory milestone. It arrives after an extended period of scrutiny around the company’s safety...
